sdk_example:
# 安装官方 SDK：pip install --upgrade spark_ai_python
from sparkai.llm.llm import ChatSparkLLM, ChunkPrintHandler
from sparkai.core.messages import ChatMessage

# Spark Lite 是官方标注的免费模型（domain: lite）
SPARKAI_URL = 'wss://spark-api.xf-yun.com/v1.1/chat'
SPARKAI_APP_ID = '你的 AppID'
SPARKAI_API_SECRET = '你的 APISecret'
SPARKAI_API_KEY = '你的 APIKey'
SPARKAI_DOMAIN = 'lite'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    spark = ChatSparkLLM(
        spark_api_url=SPARKAI_URL,
        spark_app_id=SPARKAI_APP_ID,
        spark_api_key=SPARKAI_API_KEY,
        spark_api_secret=SPARKAI_API_SECRET,
        spark_llm_domain=SPARKAI_DOMAIN,
        streaming=False,
    )
    messages = [ChatMessage(role="user", content='你好，介绍一下你自己')]
    handler = ChunkPrintHandler()
    resp = spark.generate([messages], callbacks=[handler])
